Zucchini Noodles
By: Anonymous
Published: Sunday, February 14, 2010 - 11:29am

Ingredients




1 pound Zucchini
teaspoon Salt
1 tablespoon Basil leaves

Preparation

1 Using vegetable peeler, cut zucchini lengthwise into thin strips. Or shred zucchini in food processor. Coat a large non-stick skillet with cooking spray and heat over medium-high heat. Add zucchini, salt and basil; saute until tender.
